description: An oil painting on a stretched canvas photographed against a plain white wall, with the canvas edges, its shadow and the wall all visible around it. A dark, crusted, round patty-like mound with red-pink patches sits at the centre, with orange flames and blue-grey smoke around it and white splashes at the lower right. No letters, numbers or signature, and nothing is gory.
reason: The painting is a canvas hung on a white wall, with its edges, shadow and the wall showing around it, so it does not fill the image edge to edge. Repaint it full-bleed with no canvas or wall. The subject (a burger-like patty) is acceptable.
